『機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム 鋼鉄の7人』に登場のガンダムＦ９０ Ｉタイプ（木星決戦仕様)を再現可能なミッションパックが登場！

●　ショット・ランサーを新規造形で再現。
小型核ミサイルを装備したショットランサー兼ビーム・ライフルを新規造形で付属。

Ｆ９０ ＩＩと同型の肩部パーツ、脚部推力増加ユニット、フライトシールドがセット。
ブルーの部分は木星決戦仕様に合わせ、成形色の色味を変更。
●　新規水転写式デカールが付属
木星決戦仕様の特徴である「ＲＢ」のマーキングなどを収録した水転写式デカールが新規付属。

en: There is one "Seven of Steel"
Reproduction of Minoru Suzuki's F90I type -
Jointed with "MG 1/100 GundamF90" (sold separately),
A mission pack that allows you to reproduce the Gundam F90 I type (Jupiter battle specification) that appeared in "Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam Seven of Steel" is now available!
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, this product and "MG 1/100 GundamF90" (sold separately/Premium Bandai sales item) are required.
● Reproduce Shot Lancer with new modeling.
A shot lancer and beam rifle equipped with a small nuclear missile is included with a new model.
The lance part at the tip can be removed to reproduce the injection state.
● F90 I type (Jupiter decisive battle specification) equipment set included
Set includes shoulder parts of the same type as F90 II, leg thrust increasing unit, and flight seal.
The molding color of the blue part has been changed to match the Jupiter decisive battle specifications.
● New water transfer decal included
A new water transfer decal is included that includes the "RB" markings that are characteristic of the Jupiter decisive battle specification.
Attached weapons: Shot Lancer / I type equipment set
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
